text_block_list.name: Lady
text_block_list.text: Oho, do my eyes deceive me, or is that Lady Fine before me!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …Oh! I believe the last time we saw each other was back in Ireland, was it not?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: This gentleman is a diplomat representing Ireland. He was of no small assistance when I was arranging my study abroad.

text_block_list.name: Gentleman
text_block_list.text: I do believe us meeting here again has happened for a reason. I'm actually holding a banquet at my estate. I would be most honored to have you attend.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for extending an invitation.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: However, I am afraid the decision is not mine to make.

text_block_list.name: Gentleman
text_block_list.text: Yes, I see. You are her trainer, correct? What say you?

text_block_list.name: Gentleman
text_block_list.text: It's a rather casual occasion. There's no dress code. You're both very welcome, assuming you've the time to spare.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Honestly, I'm nervous. Considering how disastrous things have been so far today, I can't help feeling anxious that I might embarrass Fine Motion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But then, I'm not just anybody—I'm her trainer. And as her trainer, my desire to support her is even more intense than that anxiety!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's. Well then, perhaps you could lead the way?

text_block_list.name: Lady
text_block_list.text: Goodness, if it isn't Lady Fine! It has been some time since our last meeting, hasn't it? I see that you've grown into a wonderful young lady.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you. And if I may, you remain as ebullient as ever yourself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I knew she had it in her, but the sheer nobility she exudes when the occasion calls for it leaves me speechless. I can't help feeling painfully out of place in comparison.

text_block_list.name: Guest
text_block_list.text: I hear that you're Lady Fine's trainer. Is that right?

text_block_list.name: Guest
text_block_list.text: I've been wanting very much to speak with you. I wonder, considering her results thus far, what manner of strategy the two of you intend to implement moving forward?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I won't blow it this time! It's time for me to step up as Fine Motion's trainer!

text_block_list.name: Guest
text_block_list.text: I see. I wasn't aware of such training methods! My niece is an Umamusume, you see. She just loves to run. Would you mind if I utilized some of those training techniques with her?

text_block_list.name: Guest
text_block_list.text: This has been extraordinarily illuminating. I very much look forward to speaking with you again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I somehow survive the conversation and slip away for a break with Fine Motion when an opportunity presents itself.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Quite an evening, wouldn't y—oh my. You seem way more stressed than I was expecting.
choice_data_list: I wanted to support you properly this time…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And you have! You've been just splendid, if you ask me. Actually, I've been subject to some praise myself.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Still… it's not our success at the party that I'm most happy about. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What's made me happiest is how hard you've been trying on my behalf.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You diligently gathered all those clues during the mystery game so I'd have a great time, and then you helped me solve the mystery as well…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And you took charge to make everything as fun as possible so I'd make plenty of lovely memories!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You were always there by my side, trying your very best. Given that you're such a hard worker, you might deny it, but…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You cannot deny this pounding in my chest.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm so proud… both of you as my trainer, and the fact that I get to work alongside such an amazing person!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Will you continue to travel down this path with me?
choice_data_list: Y-yeah! And I'm gonna work extra hard!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I thought you'd say that. And that's what makes you you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …Or something like that! ♪

text_block_list.name: Guest
text_block_list.text: Lady Fine, I wonder if I might trouble your trainer for some further conversation?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Let's! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We head back to into the crowd side-by-side. I make the conscious decision that this is where I'm going to be from now on—walking directly by her side.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh! …Hehe. So that's how you're playing it, huh? Very well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I hereby acknowledge your spirited intentions… I would very much like to extend my gratitude as well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Even if I were to return to my home far, far away, the magnificent memories I have made here in Japan would remain in my heart. Your contribution to those memories has been indispensable.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I expect great things from you… my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She stands perfectly straight as she addresses me in her noble tone. I'd better do my very best to ensure all her days are bright.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With resolve in my heart, I bow respectfully to my trainee.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Talk about gung ho! Don't go overboa—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Although… I suppose pushing past our limits will force us into new experiences… Don't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: At least, it has so far!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh. I wonder what sort of unreasonable requests I should make…
choice_data_list: Ooh… Please go easy on me!
Ooh… Please go easy on me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The words slip out and Fine Motion's smile grows wider. I see a kindness in her expression, though, and rest easy.
